issues.description: Reports cover missing or difficult downloads, download restrictions and limits, repeated downloads, offline access, and finding downloaded tracks.
Most examples report downloaded songs disappearing, alongside reports of offline playback failing or downloads moving to internal storage.
Reports include difficulty finding songs, language-specific search or lyrics issues, podcast language mismatch, and missing local files.
Most examples say songs are unavailable or absent, with additional reports of search connectivity failure and a specific catalog omission.
Most examples report missing songs, while others describe difficulty choosing among many tracks, uninteresting selection, or alleged stream filtering.
